# Repository Instructions

## Current state

- This repository is currently a minimal project containing only a README.
- No language, framework, package manager, build command, or test command has been established.

## Change guidance

- Preserve the existing minimal structure unless a task explicitly introduces an application or tooling stack.
- Before adding implementation code, establish the relevant project structure and document the commands needed to build and test it.
- Keep changes focused and avoid introducing dependencies without a concrete use.
